# Green Room

> Green Room is a free, source-available macOS menu bar app that checks your camera, microphone, and speakers before calls and recordings, shows which app is really using each device, and tells you why a device is missing. The website also has free in-browser microphone, webcam, and speaker tests.

Green Room runs on macOS 14 Sonoma and later, is signed and notarized by Apple, has no account and no analytics in the app, and never records or uploads audio or video. Install with `brew install --cask coreyhaines31/tap/greenroom` or from https://github.com/coreyhaines31/greenroom/releases/latest.

## What it does

- Camera, mic, and speaker in one panel: live camera preview, mic level meter, left/right speaker test, and a five-second "Hear Yourself" record and playback.
- Compare mics: a live level on every microphone at once, to see which one is hearing you, and one click to switch to it.
- Device names: rename devices ("Lapel mic" instead of "USB Audio Device") everywhere in the app and the `greenroom` command, and hide ones you never use from the pickers.
- Priority: rank your mics, speakers, and cameras, and Green Room switches to the highest one that's connected whenever something connects or disconnects, so AirPods or an iPhone never take over.
- Saved setups (Desk, Studio, Travel) picked automatically by which devices are plugged in, with warnings when the mic or sound switches away from your setup.
- Live now: which app (Zoom, Meet, Teams, Chrome, Loom) is using each mic and speaker, and a warning when a call uses a different mic than your setup.
- Bluetooth call mode: tells you when AirPods or another headset drops to phone-call quality because an app turned on its mic, and offers a better mic.
- Missing devices: says whether a usual device isn't plugged in (not on USB at all), is plugged in but not working, or is a Bluetooth device that isn't connected.
- Monitor tools in the full-screen record preview: histogram, waveform, zebras, false color, focus peaking, monochrome, and a LUT preview (.cube) for log footage, plus rotate and mirror for cameras mounted sideways. Nothing is recorded.
- Before calls and recordings: an optional calendar check two minutes before video calls, and a recording check (camera resolution, mic quality, disk space, power) when Loom, OBS, Screen Studio, or QuickTime starts.
- A `greenroom` command for Terminal and AI agents: `greenroom status --json` (exits 2 when something is wrong), `greenroom devices`, `greenroom use <setup>`.

## Free tests

- [Microphone test](https://greenroomformac.com/mic-test): live level meter, then record five seconds and play it back, in the browser.
- [Webcam test](https://greenroomformac.com/webcam-test): live preview with the camera's real resolution, frame rate, and lighting.
- [Speaker test](https://greenroomformac.com/speaker-test): left, right, both, and a sweep, with an output picker where supported.
- [Sound test](https://greenroomformac.com/sound-test): is any sound playing at all, and through which output.
- [Headphone test](https://greenroomformac.com/headphone-test): left/right, stereo position, and bass.
- [Left/right audio test](https://greenroomformac.com/left-right-audio-test): just the channel check.

## Mac guides

- [Hold calls during meetings](https://greenroomformac.com/hold-calls): Focus setup for Mac and iPhone, plus optional automatic holds while a mic, camera, or calendar call is active.

- [Mac microphone not working](https://greenroomformac.com/mac-microphone-not-working)
- [Mac camera not working](https://greenroomformac.com/mac-camera-not-working)
- [How to test your microphone on a Mac](https://greenroomformac.com/how-to-test-microphone-on-mac)
- [AirPods not connecting to Mac](https://greenroomformac.com/airpods-not-connecting-to-mac)
- [AirPods mic not working](https://greenroomformac.com/airpods-mic-not-working), including Bluetooth call mode
- [Stop AirPods from switching devices](https://greenroomformac.com/stop-airpods-switching-devices): Apple's iPhone and Mac steps, plus keeping your Mac on your chosen mic
- [Continuity Camera not working](https://greenroomformac.com/continuity-camera-not-working)
- [Logitech webcam not working on Mac](https://greenroomformac.com/logitech-webcam-not-working): C920, Brio, StreamCam, MX Brio
- [MacBook speakers not working](https://greenroomformac.com/macbook-speakers-not-working)
- [Lighting for Zoom calls](https://greenroomformac.com/zoom-lighting)

## App fixes

- [Fix your camera, mic, or sound in any app](https://greenroomformac.com/fix): step-by-step fixes for Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Discord, FaceTime, Slack huddles, Webex, OBS, and Loom on a Mac, each starting with that app's own settings.

## Comparisons

- [SoundSource alternative](https://greenroomformac.com/soundsource-alternative): SoundSource (per-app volume, routing, EQ; $49) vs Green Room (free; device checks and priority), and when to use both.

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/coreyhaines31/greenroom): source, issues, and releases under FSL-1.1-MIT.
